summary: Replaced unverified tenant selection and demo fallbacks with expiring authenticated identity, current database membership/role checks, scoped predicates and repository rejection of missing organization context.

Implemented project and task CRUD with captured versions, conditional concurrent updates/deletes, transactional retained audit, explicit referenced-project deletion rules and a composite tenant/project foreign key.
Added bounded strict requests, literal paginated search, consistent count/list reads, request IDs, controlled errors, loopback services and process-local sign-in throttling.

Built a complete React workspace with in-memory sessions, organization-specific caches, role-appropriate controls, separate preserved drafts, conflict export/reconciliation, confirmed tenant changes and independent save/refresh feedback.

Added reproducible workspace configuration, generated non-overwriting local credentials, a fresh PostgreSQL migration and non-overwriting fictional seed, 55 checks, reviewed screenshots and nine detailed source-grounded learning documents.

checks.environment: Node 22.16.0; Prisma 6.19.2; PostgreSQL 18; React 18; Vite 5.4.21; Playwright 1.60 Chromium
checks.command: node scripts/test-database.mjs verify (36 backend, 6 frontend, 3 setup, 10 browser; builds; seed twice; owned cluster shutdown)

limits: Local demonstration accounts and process-local throttling; no MFA, invitations, refresh tokens, server-side session revocation, distributed limits, row-level security or production deployment.
Membership is checked on every request, without a claim of atomic revocation against already in-flight operations.

Fresh dedicated database migration only; no automatic upgrade of unknown existing data, power-loss certification or full accessibility audit. Docker configuration provided but verification used installed PostgreSQL binaries.
No durable create idempotency or automatic draft import/merge. Audits retain minimal metadata; task audit exists in PostgreSQL without a dedicated UI.
